mechanism: CBar stores MqlRates plus derived candle geometry: CandleSize=High-Low, BodySize=|Close-Open|, BodyHigh/BodyLow, ShadowUp/ShadowDown, and ENUM_BAR_BODY_TYPE (bullish/bearish/zero bar/zero-body candle). Bars live in a CSeries list (default depth 1000) sortable/filterable via CSelect::ByBarProperty on any integer/real/string property so candle-formation queries become property predicates over a window.
data_needed: CopyRates OHLC + tick/real volume + spread; symbol digits; MqlDateTime for year/month/dow/hour/minute fields

quote: All these properties allow us to look for any combinations of bars and candles (stored in the bar list) within the range.

mechanism: CNewBarObj compares current bar open time to previous: IsNewBar auto-latches PrevTime=Time and fires once; IsNewBarManual keeps returning true on each tick until SaveNewBarTime is called so multi-step work can finish on the new bar. For indicators on own symbol/TF, time comes from OnCalculate time[]; else SeriesInfoInteger(SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE).

quote: Till the previous time is forcibly set as the current one from the program, the method returns the new bar flag allowing the completion of all the necessary actions on the new bar.

mechanism: CTimeSeries holds one CSeries per ENUM_TIMEFRAMES slot (indexed M1…MN1) for a single symbol; SetAmountUsedData/SyncData/Create/Refresh operate on one TF or all. Enables multi-period history search and new-bar detection across periods of one symbol from one object.
data_needed: Symbol name; per-TF history depth (default 1000); rates_total when indicator on current TF

quote: the programs often require the use of multi-period analysis of history of one or several symbols. The symbol timeseries object contains multiple timeseries of all possible timeframes of one symbol.

mechanism: CTimeSeriesCollection stores CTimeSeries objects for every used symbol; CreateCollection from symbol list; SetAvailable/SetRequiredUsedData/SyncData/CreateSeries/Refresh overload by symbol, TF, or all. SYMBOLS_MODE and TIMEFRAMES_MODE select current/list/MarketWatch/all. Each series tracks firstdate/lastbar_date and available flag.
data_needed: Used-symbol list; comma-separated TF string; SERIES_FIRSTDATE/LASTBAR_DATE; optional rates_total
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Configurable symbol modes; all terminal TFs; multi-symbol collection
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a single in-memory bar database across instruments×periods with enable flags—backbone for multi-asset regime panels.
quote: we get one object that contains all the data for a given number of bars for each timeseries of each symbol.

mechanism: CNewTickObj stores MqlTick prev/current; IsNewTick uses SymbolInfoTick and returns true iff time_msc differs (first launch false). CTimeSeries embeds it; collection RefreshOther/Refresh skip unless IsNewTick so non-chart symbols update only on their own ticks in a 32ms timer, while native symbol updates in OnTick/OnCalculate.
data_needed: SymbolInfoTick time_msc per tracked symbol; timer COLLECTION_TS_PAUSE=32ms
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Program chart symbol vs other Market Watch symbols; all their used TFs
why_new_for_mis: Tick-arrival change sensor for off-chart instruments—lets MIS refresh multi-symbol state only when that symbol actually prints, not on timer spam.
quote: If the time of a new tick is not equal to the time of a tick during the previous check - copy data of the obtained tick to the previous tick data and return 'true'

mechanism: ENUM_SERIES_EVENT {NO_EVENT, NEW_BAR}; CSeries::SendEvent does EventChartCustom(main_chart, SERIES_EVENTS_NEW_BAR, Time(0), Timeframe, Symbol). CTimeSeries Refresh/RefreshAll call SendEvent when IsNewBar fires so any TF/symbol new-bar is delivered as a chart event to the control program.

mechanism: For indicators, Copy* returns immediately and may start download; library skips creating the own-symbol/current-TF series at init to avoid conflicts, then GetSeriesEmpty/ReCreateSeries fills it from OnCalculate rates_total. SDataCalculate carries rates_total/prev_calculated/MqlRates into Refresh; empty/incomplete series scanners drive retry sync.

mechanism: Replace BAR_PROP_INDEX with BAR_PROP_TIME as primary key; sort/search by open time. Index(timeframe) is computed via iBarShift(Symbol, TF, Time). GetBar(datetime) and GetBar(uint index→iTime→GetBar(time)) keep real-time updates stable when a new bar would otherwise renumber every list index.

mechanism: GetBarsData maps current-chart bar → foreign symbol/TF bar via GetBarSeriesFirstFromSeriesSecond and returns num_bars=PeriodSeconds(HTF)/PeriodSeconds(LTF). IndexBarPeriodByBarCurrent(series_index, symbol, TF) uses iBarShift(symbol, TF, bar.Time()) so calculated buffers of MA/MACD from another symbol/period align to the host loop index.
